name: Falling Crates
disable: DC 17 Thievery check (trained) to carefully remove the trip wire.

items.name: Tumble Down
items.text:
Trigger A creature trips the wire

---
Effect Several heavy crates come crashing down in the 10-foot square area marked on the map, dealing 2d10+10 bludgeoning damage to each creature in that area (DC 20 basic Reflex save save). A creature who critically fails the save is knocked Prone.

text: A tower of precariously stacked crates is rigged to fall when someone steps through a trip wire.
